MenuItemExtension.description: MenuItem is an entry of a module's menu: it opens a page (PageID), runs a report or codeunit (RunObject "report:93", "codeunit:6"), holds a sub-menu (Items, e.g. Setup, Activities) or is a separator. Enabled is set when the menu is sent: the entry's object exists and the user may run it (a sub-menu: one of its entries is available); an entry without one is shown greyed out (not built yet, or Denied).

after.description: Placed after this one (a field by its source, the others by name); else at the end.

before.description: Placed before this one (a field by its source, the others by name).

in.description: The sub-menu it is added to: a name, or the path of names from the top. Without in: a new module.
